fp6_model.claim_boundary: This model classifies investigation and private bring-up inputs. It does not claim that an FP6 image builds, boots, passes compatibility testing or is eligible for public promotion. Accepted public dispositions require generated artifact closure and the recorded qualification evidence.
fp6_model.artifact_inventory_owner: The generated FP6 input and target-files pipeline supplies artifact paths, hashes and dependencies. This model owns component decisions and rejects unmapped closure data rather than duplicating extracted-file lists.
fp6_model.update_rule: A changed stock build, region, source revision, platform manifest, generated artifact, dependency, qualification result or maintenance status invalidates the affected decision and requires model revalidation.
